//: Editor type checking. `undefined-field` and `need-check-nil` are the valuable ones here: they catch a config key that does not exist, which at runtime shows up only as a dead thread. FiveM native definitions come from dev/fivem-lls-addon (overextended/fivem-lls-addon, vendored - never edited, only replaced wholesale on update), so undefined-global stays off by default: it would otherwise flag every native as unknown, which drowned out everything else before this was added. `unknown-symbol`/`err-nonstandard-symbol` are disabled below because this is genuinely non-standard Lua - Cfx's fork adds `+=`-style compound assignment (used throughout this codebase) that the vanilla parser this tool ships doesn't understand, and its default quote-style opinion (double quotes) fights the project's own established single-quote convention. Neither is a real defect; both are noise from checking Cfx Lua with a parser that only knows standard Lua.
